name: Tracing the Source
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Something funny about the cologne? It's possible. I've never seen so many people after one product like this.

Look, if there's something wrong with it, I want to know, too. I bought my supply from a merchant named Evert Sorisam. He's new in town.

He mentioned he had some goods he was going to deliver to The Finest Thread.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Evert Sorisam at The Finest Thread along Stormwind's Canals.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Yes, of course. Those fragrances are the hottest items this season. You must be the fifth or sixth person this hour to inquire about them.

I'm afraid my supplies are all sold out. If you'd like some, you should speak with Allison, the innkeeper of The Gilded Rose.

You shouldn't waste any time, though. I think you'll find the perfume will be irresistible.
